s.note: the doc who needs the cash as much as they do
s.how: Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once. Toss in 100ml hot sauce melted with 50g butter. For the dip, mash 100g blue cheese into 150g sour cream with a squeeze of lemon. Serve the wings hot with the dip and celery sticks.

s.note: Mitch losing one job after another
s.how: Cut 500g pizza dough into 32 small pieces. Simmer 2L water with 60g bicarb, drop in the pieces for 20 seconds and drain. Lay on a lined tray, brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. Stir 3 tbsp American mustard, 1 tbsp hot English mustard and 2 tbsp honey together for dipping and serve the bites warm.

m.note: Pops, Sam's dad, who needs the operation
m.how: Slowly fry 3 sliced onions in 30g butter for 20 minutes. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 thin oval patties and cook 3 minutes a side. Layer each on buttered rye with Swiss cheese and onions and fry until golden and melted.

w.note: the revenge plan on the crooked developer
w.how: Heat 150ml thickened cream with 60g brown sugar and 30g butter until it bubbles. Off the heat, stir in 120g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of salt until glossy. Roughly chop 80g salted roasted peanuts. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 sundae glasses. Pour over the warm fudge, top with whipped cream from 150ml cream, scatter with the peanuts and finish each with a cherry.

d.note: a drink with Pops, Sam's old man
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Pour 45ml rye whiskey into each. Add a squeeze of lime juice and 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Top each with 150ml cold ginger ale and stir once gently so it keeps the fizz. Garnish with a lime wedge. For anyone not drinking, make it with ginger ale, lime and bitters only.
